relations.subject: Seungsahn Haengwon
relations.evidence: Upon his release, he studied Western philosophy at Dongguk University.

relations.subject: Seungsahn Haengwon
relations.evidence: He then went to see Kobong, who confirmed Seungsahn's enlightenment on January 25, 1949, and gave him dharma transmission as well.

relations.subject: Seungsahn Haengwon
relations.evidence: After the sesshin was concluded, he received dharma transmission (inka) from two masters, Keumbong and Keum'oh.

relations.subject: Jacob Perl
relations.evidence: Among these first students was Jacob Perl (Wubong), who helped to found the Providence Zen Center with the others.

relations.subject: Dae Gak
relations.evidence: In 1986, along with a former student and Dharma heir Dae Gak, Seungsahn founded a retreat center and temple in Clay City, Kentucky called Furnace Mountain

relations.subject: Myong Gong Sunim
